violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: sushi rice 121F in countertop rice warmer and yellow nacho cheese 119F countertop warmer on prepline
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: CFM reheated sushi rice and yellow nacho cheese to 165F before transferring back to rice warmer and countertop warmer on prepline.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed that clean plastic spoons in plastic container stored directly under the soap dispenser at the front hand sink and stored in a manner that exposed the item (s) to contamination (soap dripping from dispenser and possibly employees wet hands.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. CDI: EHS relocated plastic container of plastic spoons to area away from possible contamination.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Observed several ice bins that have been cleaned not stored covered or inverted under Ecolab bug lamp in the kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Clean equipment and utensils shall be stored covered or inverted to prevent contamination. CDI: CFM washed, rinsed, and sanitized ice bins and stored inverted near the ice machine.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked chicken wings in #3 (46F), vanilla soft serve in VEVOR (51F).
violations.corrective_action: The CFM discarded the the food items during the inspection for compliance. The soft serve machine was discontinued for operation.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: deep container of chopped TCS fruit and deep container of cooked chicken wings cooling in refrigeration units.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM discussed proper cooling methods (shallow dishes) with the food service workers for guidance. The large container of chicken wings was discarded due to temperature issues.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: the vanilla soft serve ice cream in VEVOR ice cream machine (51F). The machine was not maintaining the ice cream at the appropriate temperature.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM removed the remaining ice cream and discontinued the use of the machine, during the inspection.
